author: Joseph Griffin
title: Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 2nd (AAPL, ALLY, AMGN, BIIB, CFCOU, FC, KTOS, MOMO, TWLO, VCEL)
text:
Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 2nd (AAPL, ALLY, AMGN, BIIB, CFCOU, FC, KTOS, MOMO, TWLO, VCEL) Tweet 
Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Tuesday, January 2nd: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. They currently have a $200.00 price target on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts: 
Ally Financial (NYSE:ALLY) had its overweight rating reissued by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a $36.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $26.00. Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. 
Biogen (NASDAQ:BIIB) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. 
JPMorgan Chase & Co. assumed coverage on shares of FGL (NASDAQ:CFCOU) . The firm issued a neutral rating on the stock. 
Franklin Covey (NYSE:FC) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at B. Riley. B. Riley currently has a $21.00 target price on the stock. 
Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (NASDAQ:KTOS) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at B. Riley. The firm currently has a $16.00 price target on the stock. 
UBS Group AG initiated coverage on shares of Momo (NASDAQ:MOMO) . They issued a hold rating and a $28.00 target price on the stock. 
Twilio (NYSE:TWLO) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Oppenheimer Holdings Inc.. They currently have a $38.00 target price on the stock. 
Vericel (NASDAQ:VCEL) had its overweight rating reaffirmed by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. They currently have a $9.00 price target on the stock. 
Voya Financial (NYSE:VOYA) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at BTIG Research. BTIG Research currently has a $59.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “CBVA and Removal of Tail Risk = Much Higher Multiple We are reiterating our Buy recommendation on Voya Financial (VOYA) while raising our price target to $59 (from $50) based on 1.1x the company’s FY18E book value ex. accumulated other cumulative income (AOCI) of $53.27. We view VOYA’s agreement to sell its closed block variable annuity (CBVA) unit to Venerable, a newly-formed firm backed by a group of private equity firms led by Apollo, and to have its fixed annuity book reinsured by Athene Holding (ATH, Not Rated), as a game-changer for the company.”” 
UBS Group AG assumed coverage on shares of Weibo (NASDAQ:WB) . The firm issued a buy rating and a $125.00 target price on the stock. 
Weatherford International (NYSE:WFT) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Gabelli. 
UBS Group AG started coverage on shares of YY (NASDAQ:YY) . UBS Group AG issued a buy rating and a $135.00 price target on the stock.   Apple Inc   Apple Inc
